blocks.text: For three days, the NUSTAR Resort waterfront became a meeting point for more than 1,300 paddlers from Cebu, different parts of the Philippines, and overseas as the 2026 NUSTAR Dragon Boat Regatta concluded on September 20. Now in its second year, the competition grew significantly from its debut. This year introduced a corporate category, welcomed seven international teams, and brought athletes together across seven categories. Growing the sport from Cebu Dragon boat racing may not be among the first sports associated with the province, but over the weekend, the waterfront was filled with athletes, supporters, families, and international guests experiencing Cebu […]...
